title: OCCT FFI Safe Handle Lifecycle

oracle.positive: HandleStore cấp phát slot + generation; get/remove O(1); slot được tái dùng với generation mới.
oracle.negative: Handle cũ sau khi xoá là stale (không alias object mới); xoá hai lần trả StaleHandle; store không rò slot.

reviewer.role: plan gate: this L3 is the Rust-side adapter half and needs no human test
reviewer.statement: This L3's oracle is the Rust adapter contract (records, validation, handle lifetime, error contract, policy) and it is fully covered by brep_kernel tests. The native OCCT implementation behind the trait is NOT part of this L3's claim: the unlinked backend refuses every kernel call by name.
reviewer.scope: the adapter and its records, never the OCCT kernel or the window
